sources.title: Deepseek-v4-Flash 0731 GGUF (NEW model) - NVIDIA Developer Forums
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is the July 31 update to the Flash model, delivering the best performance for its size and outperforming V4-Pro (Preview). Designed for coding, agentic and chat workflows with a 1M context window.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: The lossless 8-bit GGUF is 162 GB and 3-bit is 103GB which can run on a 110GB RAM device. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 scores 82.7% on Terminal Bench 2.1, 54.4% on DeepSWE, and 54.2% on NL2Repo. DSpark is also enabled for GGUFs, enabling up to 2x faster decoding speed! Aug 13: DeepSeek- V4-Pro-0813 was released and quants are now available to run.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 · Models - modelscope.ai
sources.snippet: It has the same model structure as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark, i.e. it comes with a speculative decoding module attached. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 outperforms DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Preview) on benchmarks listed below despite its far smaller activated parameter count, and is broadly competitive with the strongest proprietary models available.
